About us

A scrap shop built on honest weight.

I started buying scrap in Hyderabad with my uncle, who taught me the one rule he never broke: put the scale where the customer can see it. Over the years I watched people get cheated by a bent scale or a quick mental sum, and I promised myself our shop would never work that way.

Today my team and I go to flats, offices, shops and sites around HITEC City and Gachibowli. We check the material, tell you the rate, weigh it while you watch and pay you before the vehicle leaves.

Sardar Traders, Hyderabad

  • Weighing in front of you. Digital scale, you see every reading.
  • Rate told before pickup. No changing numbers at the door.
  • Payment on the spot. Cash or UPI once the weighing is done.
  • Bulk and office clearance. We handle lifting and loading ourselves.
  • Mixed lots accepted. Metal, wires, electronics and appliances together.
